messages:
Nora (SRE): Postmortem posted for the overnight throughput degradation: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-07-throughput-degen. Main ask: SLO refinements and a small set of follow-ups.
Ben T: Saw it. The spike is confined to the 02:30-03:05 UTC batch window and mostly affects tail latency P99.9. Average SLOs hide it.
Clara W: Suggest we introduce two new SLIs: route_p99_9 (5m window) and sustained_throughput (5m rolling avg). Also split error-budget reporting by tenant tier.
Nora (SRE): Draft targets: route_p99_9 <= 1100ms at 99.6% monthly; sustained_throughput >= 92% baseline (baseline = median weekday 02:00-04:00). We'll validate in shadow for 10 days.
Ben T: PromQL for p99.9 (per-route, 5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Throughput SLI (5m avg):
```
avg_over_time(sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m])) by (route)[5m:1m])
```
Clara W: I'll own dashboards and the per-tenant watchlist that flags >25% error budget burn.
Nora (SRE): I'll open tracking ticket RED-4999 and add owners/dates. Proposed actions:
- Clara W: dashboard panels + watchlist job + daily spike email (due Fri)
- Ben T: alert rules + staging rollout (preemptive P99.9 > 1.1s for 3/5 windows; throughput drop >20% for >10m) (due Thu)
- Nora (SRE): postmortem update with SLO proposal + PM/legal sync for SLA notes (due Mon)
infra-bot: Observed batch-pattern id batch-2026-07-B: 02:25-03:10 UTC peak across 7 tenants.
slo-bot: Incident INC-2026-0714-01 linked.
Nora (SRE): Also long-term remediation: require jitter for scheduled heavy jobs and tenant concurrency caps. Who can coordinate with batch infra?
Ben T: I'll open the infra RFC and implement tenant caps and jitter (due next Wed).
Clara W: We'll also add a dashboard heatmap "Hourly tail latency by route" and a weekly digest for SRE leads.
Nora (SRE): Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept assignments.
Ben T: :white_check_mark: taking infra changes and alerts.
Clara W: :white_check_mark: taking dashboards/watchlist.
Nora (SRE): Setting meeting for SLO sign-off after validation: 2026-07-28 10:00 UTC. Thanks all, logging actions to postmortem now.
